defects.defect: A flat dark-brown band separates the sand arena from the HUD; the arena floor ends in an unpainted curve with empty dead space, reading as letterboxing rather than a finished environment
defects.direction: Extend the painted sand/ground art down to meet the HUD frame, or dress the brown band as a painted ledge with texture, edge trim and props so the camp ledge reads as terrain
defects.region: bottom of arena, y≈1100-1215, full width

defects.defect: Large empty vertical gap separates the fighting cluster from Sage and the camp, weakening the staged battle composition.
defects.direction: Tighten the active encounter area or add mid-arena dressing and combat activity.

defects.defect: The 1x speed chip overhangs the left edge of the wooden strip frame, its diamond points crossing the frame border rather than sitting inside the panel padding
defects.direction: Inset the speed chip fully inside the strip's inner bounds with even left padding matching the pause button's right padding
defects.region: top strip, speed chip x≈40-130 y≈245-295

defects.defect: Pause button sits on an opaque lighter-brown square that overlaps and breaks the strip's top and right frame trim instead of compositing inside the panel
defects.direction: Remove the opaque backing square, use a round framed button inset within the panel and vertically centered on the title row
defects.region: top strip, pause button x≈600-700 y≈230-300

defects.defect: The three mages are rendered at noticeably smaller sprite scale than the goblin cluster and are drably grey/unlit, so the player's own units read as less important than the enemies
defects.direction: Increase hero sprite scale to match or exceed goblin scale and add the saturated painted palette and rim light used on the enemies
defects.region: mage trio: Bastion/Ember center y≈630-790, Sage lower-right y≈960-1110

defects.defect: No damage numbers or hit feedback are rendered; only a small white projectile and a yellow dot trail appear, so combat readability is absent
defects.direction: Add outlined, drop-shadowed floating damage numbers above struck goblins with crit styling so hits are readable against the sand

defects.defect: Ember and Bastion overlap heavily, making their silhouettes and forward melee positioning unclear.
defects.direction: Separate the two melee mages into distinct advancing lanes toward the goblins.

defects.defect: Stage track is a bare thin line with unlabeled plain nodes, half-hidden behind a cactus and skull prop at y≈820-900, and its top node is clipped/floating with no start or end cap framing
defects.direction: Give the track a framed rail with legible stage markers (numbers/icons), keep props from overlapping node hitboxes, and anchor both ends to the top strip and the camp
defects.region: left edge stage track, x≈20-55, y≈460-1100

defects.defect: Card internals are misaligned: HP bars and HP text hang past the inner frame toward the right edge, and the two gear tiles are left-biased leaving a large empty gutter on the right of each card
defects.direction: Center the HP bar, HP label and the gear tile pair within each card's inner panel with symmetric left/right padding

defects.defect: Hero names use plain sans text in three different flat colors with no outline or shadow, clashing with the framed wooden panel styling and the display face used for 'Level 1'
defects.direction: Use the title display face with a dark outline/drop shadow and a consistent name color treatment across all three cards

defects.defect: The three mage cards sit very tightly against one another and the outer edges.
defects.direction: Introduce slightly more consistent gutters around and between the cards.

defects.defect: Arena props (skull and flowering cactus) sit directly on top of the stage track, partially obscuring a track node

defects.defect: Arena dressing is unbalanced: crates, rocks and cacti cluster on the right flank while the left flank has only the track and one cactus, so the environment reads unfinished
defects.direction: Distribute props across both flanks with matching density and depth layering so the arena reads as a dressed environment

defects.defect: Goblins are densely stacked and heavily overlapping, and the topmost goblins are clipped by the arena's top edge under the title frame
